name: modelarmor
ruby-cloud-description: Model Armor helps you protect against risks like prompt injection, harmful content, and data leakage in generative AI applications by letting you define policies that filter user prompts and model responses. Note that google-cloud-modelarmor-v1 is a version-specific client library. For most uses, we recommend installing the main client library google-cloud-modelarmor instead. See the readme for more details.
